title: What Is the Deepest Point on Earth?
description:
Mount Everest could fit inside this trench—with more than a mile of water still above it.

Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench, roughly 11 kilometres below sea level.

It formed at a subduction zone where one tectonic plate bends beneath another.

Pressure near the bottom is more than a thousand times sea-level atmospheric pressure.
